title: Task params for oedis.handler.file.flatten
description: Configuration for flattening inbox files into a single destination directory using basename-only file names.

requests.description: List of flatten instructions. Each item describes which inbox files to collect recursively and how they should be flattened into the destination directory.

src_dir.description: Inbox-relative source directory to read from. Empty or omitted means ctx.inbox. The resolved path must stay inside ctx.inbox.

dst_dir.description: Inbox-relative destination directory for flattened files. Empty or omitted means ctx.inbox. The resolved path must stay inside ctx.inbox and must not normalize to the same path as src_dir.

include.description: File match pattern or list of patterns to include. Patterns are matched against each source file path relative to src_dir.

exclude.description: File match pattern or list of patterns to exclude after include matching. Patterns are matched against each source file path relative to src_dir.

operation.description: Whether matched files should be moved or copied into the flattened destination directory.

on_collision.description: How source-name collisions are handled after flattening to basename-only paths.
